focus: mimo-02: Active skill-advisor recommendations, the proof

label: Tie-break headroom is UNKNOWN until top-2 margins are counted: the absolute ceiling is 6 rows on the 24-row ambiguity slice and 17 on the 70-row holdout, but no capture records how many rows are near-tied

The eval slice was cut at tau 0.03 while the live ambiguity cluster admits 0.05 on score OR confidence, so an arm gated on the slice measures a narrower population than the operator ever sees ambiguity on

The measured arm is an offline jev choice over top-2 or top-3 skill ids on margin-eligible rows, holdout as the headline, recorded to JSONL and never served, and never recaptured into the deterministic ratchet baseline

The shadow delta sink is opt-in via SPECKIT_ADVISOR_SHADOW_DELTA_PATH or SPECKIT_ADVISOR_SHADOW_DELTA_ENABLED because advisor_recommend is a read-style call, and its path must stay under the workspace root
A tie-break cannot move the 13 unknowns and 5 gold-none false fires, and the H2 rerank script skips gold-none rows entirely so an abstention arm needs the H1 corpus path instead

During measurement the operator sees nothing of Jev-scorer disagreements; the only UX-clean post-measurement surface is a suggested order inside the existing ambiguousWith cluster with the cluster still shown
